This file exists so `go build` stays green even when `dist/` has just been
emptied and rebuilt: Vite copies everything under public/ into dist/
verbatim on every build (N9, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-dubplate-uploader.md),
so this file rides along next to index.html and the hashed assets rather
than being deleted by build.emptyOutDir. web/dist/placeholder.txt is the
same content, committed separately so `//go:embed all:dist` in embed.go
has a non-empty directory on a fresh checkout that has never run `npm run
build`.
